description: Gold expectations for the fixture-replay filing-index probe (ADR-090). Table identity, not column shape, decides: page one places a DECOY Data Files table FIRST that carries the same Document and Type columns and a plausible 10-K row ('decoy-20211231x10k.htm'); the parser must reject it and read only the table identified as Document Format Files. Page two supplies that identity through an associated heading rather than a summary attribute, and its primary is 'form10-kt.htm', which no ticker-and-date filename pattern would match. Selection is by declared type; planned_probes comes from the plan and probes_resolved from observations, so their equality is a real completeness check.
